children: WELL Health Technologies has appointed Evelyn Sutherland as its new chief financial officer, effective Sept. 21.

Sutherland brings to the digital health company more than 20 years of senior financial leadership experience across both public and private organizations. WELL Health said Wednesday that she has worked across a number of industries, including retail, consumer services, utilities and real estate, most recently as CFO of Staples Canada. Before that, she also held the CFO position at home and commercial services company Enercare, KEYreit and Unified Purchasing Group of Canada.
She also served on the board Andlauer Healthcare Group until the company was acquired by UPS in 2025.
The company said she also has served on the board of WELL Health's subsidiary, Wellstar Technologies, where she supported the transition to a public company.
She succeeds Eva Fong, who is set to assume a strategic executive adviser position at WELL Health.
